Container.Name: YJS
Container.Overview:
Yjs relay for real-time collaborative editing in the OpenCloud Editor.
It is a pure WebSocket relay: it stores no content and needs no appdata folder.
OpenCloud reaches it through the proxy.yaml route /yjs -> http://YJS:1234, browsers through the reverse proxy at https://opencloud.yourdomain.com/yjs. It can be created any time and does not block the OpenCloud start.
Only Markdown and .ocnote files support collaboration.
Container.Requires: Needs the OpenCloud container on the same Docker network, with the /yjs route in its proxy.yaml.

Config.Name: OpenCloud URL
Config.Description: Internal URL the relay uses to reach OpenCloud

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal listen port, not published. Must match the /yjs route in proxy.yaml.

Config.Name: SHUTDOWN_GRACE_PERIOD_MS
Config.Description: Graceful shutdown grace period in milliseconds
